contexts.text: The six days, or times, which are so many successive states of regeneration. AC 62.
The sixth state is when he speaks truths and does goods from faith and thence from love, (thus) becoming a spiritual man, (and being in) combat. Explained.
Rarely does anyone come to the sixth state.
At the end of the sixth day evil Spirits recede, and good ones succeed, and he is introduced into Heaven.
That man has now become so far spiritual that he is the sixth day. Signified. AC 83.
Six = labour, from the six days of labour or combat.
Six = labour and combat. AC 4178.
As six = labour and combat, it also = the dispersion of what is false. Illustrated.

Elsewhere, six does not = labour, combat, or the dispersion of what is false, but what is holy of faith, because it relates to twelve, and to three, whence is the genuine derivation of the number six. Illustrated. The reason of this derivation is that in the combat of temptation there is what is holy of faith; and also because the six days of labour and combat regard the holy seventh one.
Six, as preceding seven, = what is not holy, but relatively profane.
Six, as preceding seven, = in general all that state which precedes. This is the signification of six in application to any subject of which it is predicated.
Six = combat. AC 1963.
Six = labour or combat.
There are in general twelve classes in the Lord's Kingdom; but here there are six, (which) = the same. AC 3960.
Six = the same as twelve, namely, all things of faith and love.
Six names which frequently occur in the Prophets. Enumerated.
Six = the same as three.
On the sixth day () = at the end of every state. Explained. AC 8488.
Truth Divine in the sixth degree.
The six previous days represented combat and labour, consequently, the temptations which precede a state of peace.

Six days ye shall gather it () = the reception of truth before it is conjoined with good; for six days = a state of labour and combat; here, a state of the reception of truth, or a state when good is acquired through truth; for in this state there is labour and combat. Explained.
The six days (in Genesis) = temptations and combats.

He gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days () = up to the end of the former state He gives so much of good through truth, that conjunction may afterwards be effected. The sixth day = the end of the prior state.
The prior state (of regeneration) is signified by the six days which precede the seventh.
Six days shalt thou labour () = the combat which precedes and prepares for this marriage. Six = combat. Explained.
There are no six days of labour there.
In six days Jehovah made... () = regeneration and vivification... Six days, when predicated of the Lord, = the labour with man before he is being regenerated.
Six years shall he serve. See Serve.
Six years shalt thou sow the land () = the first state when the man of the Church is being instructed...
Six days shalt thou do thy works () = a state of labour and combat while in external delights which are to be conjoined with internal. AC 9278:3.
Six days () = while in a state of truth. Explained.
Six reeds (of the candlestick) = all things of truth from good in the complex. Six = all things in the complex. AC 9561.
Six boards () = good from the Divine Human in every way.
The six days which precede the seventh = the former Church up to its end, and the instauration of the new one.
Six names on one stone () = the whole quality of truths from good. Six = all things.
The triplication of the senary number involves the end.
In the Spiritual Kingdom the correspondent numbers are 12, 6, and 3; for by these are signified all things; and, when predicated of truths and goods, all truths and goods in the complex.
The time and state while the Lord was in combats is signified by the six days of labour.
Six days shall work be done () = the state which precedes and prepares for the heavenly marriage.

In six days Jehovah made heaven and earth () = the state of combat and labour while the Church is being instaurated. Six days, when the instauration of the Church and the regeneration of man are treated of, = a state of combat against evils and falsities, thus a state which precedes and prepares for the conjunction of good and truth.
3, 6, and 12 belong to the spiritual class.
Six days thou shalt work () = the first state of regeneration, when man is in truths, and is then in combats against evils and falsities. AC 10729, Explained.
Six days shall work be done (), in the supreme sense, = the glorification of the Lord's Human.
Six wings () = (all) the powers and guards... Six = all as to truth and good; for 6 comes forth from 3 and 2 multiplied together; and 3 = all as to truth, and 2 all as to good.
3, and 6, are predicated of truths, and signify them.
Six = what is complete to the end, because it is the double of three.

Six = the same as 3 times 2, and 3 = full, and all, and is predicated of truths; and 2 = the marriage of truth and good; and as 6 is compounded of these two numbers multiplied together, it = all the truth of good in the Word; here, it falsified.
That six = full, and all, and is said where the truths of good are treated of. Illustrated.
Six virgins stood at the side of the bride (because) the number six = all, and what is complete.
Wives have a sixth sense.
The six days of labour = combat against the flesh and its concupiscences.
Six steps (of Solomon's throne) = all things from primes to ultimates.
Six = spiritual good; for six = communication; and communication with the Lord is through charity towards the neighbour.
Six = all things, and is predicated of truths.
From the sixth to the ninth hour () = that there was mere falsity and no truth whatever; for... six, and nine = all things in the complex; here, falsities and evils.
Six = the same as three; namely, truths in the whole complex.
Six weeks = the same as the six days of one week, namely, a state of combat and of labour, consequently the end, when the Church has been completely vastated, or when evil has been consummated.

Six = all things, and is predicated of truths and of the derivative goods; and, in the opposite, of falsities and the derivative evils. For this number is composed of 2 and 3 multiplied together; and 2 is predicated of goods, and in the opposite of evils; and 3 of truths, and in the opposite of falsities. Hence it is that six = all truths and the derivative goods in the complex; and, in the opposite, all falsities and the derivative evils in the complex.
